description: Return the next public holiday on or after a date for an emirate/sector: names (EN/AR), dates, status, days until, source. Use for 'when is the next long weekend / holiday' questions and to warn about upcoming closures. Example: {from_date:'2026-10-31', emirate:'federal', sector:'public'} → Eid Al Etihad 2–3 Dec 2026, estimated, 32 days away. Response always includes data_confidence ('high' = all dates officially announced/confirmed, 'medium' = something is estimated), estimated_items[], sources[] (official URLs) and data_version.

emirate.description: Calendar profile emirate: federal | abu_dhabi | dubai | sharjah | ajman | umm_al_quwain | ras_al_khaimah | fujairah. Use 'federal' unless the user named an emirate's government. Emirates other than Sharjah currently follow the federal weekend.
emirate.title: Emirate

sector.description: Sector: public (government) | private. Government employees, courts and ministries → 'public'. Companies → 'private' (weekend is employer-set; the common Sat–Sun default is used and flagged).
